title: Bug Triage: Double-Charge on Stripe Webhook Retries
problem_brief: Customers are complaining about being billed twice for their monthly subscription renewals. The Stripe webhook handler was recently refactored to support async processing. Investigate the pull request diff, unit test suite, and webhook server logs to identify the race condition/idempotency failure, write a mitigation plan, and design the fix.

evidence_tabs.label: Pull Request Diff

entries.message: Stripe timeout waiting for 200 OK (network blip)
Second insert for evt_109283 executed without uniqueness check

evidence_tabs.label: Database Schema
evidence_tabs.content:
```sql
CREATE TABLE payments (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  stripe_event_id VARCHAR(255),
  status VARCHAR(50),
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
  -- NOTE: UNIQUE constraint on stripe_event_id was dropped during v1.8 migration
);
```

submission_fields.label: 1. Root Cause & Race Condition Explanation
submission_fields.placeholder: Explain how the refactor removed the idempotency guard and what happened on network retry...
submission_fields.guidance: Explain the interaction between Stripe retries, concurrency, and DB uniqueness.

submission_fields.label: 2. Proposed Code Fix & Idempotency Strategy
submission_fields.placeholder: Provide the pseudocode or TypeScript solution ensuring strict idempotency...
submission_fields.guidance: Mention database-level constraints as well as application logic.

submission_fields.label: 3. Regression Test Design
submission_fields.placeholder: Describe the unit/integration test to guarantee double-delivery cannot reoccur...
submission_fields.guidance: How will you simulate concurrent duplicate webhook deliveries?

submission_fields.label: 4. Customer Data Remediation Plan
submission_fields.placeholder: How should the existing duplicate transactions in the database be audited and refunded?

dimensions.name: Idempotency & Concurrency Mechanics
dimensions.criteria: Correctly diagnoses the missing pre-check, lack of DB unique constraint, and unhandled concurrent retry.

dimensions.name: Code Architecture & Safety
dimensions.criteria: Proposes adding a unique database constraint on stripe_event_id and an atomic upsert/transaction.

dimensions.name: Regression Test Quality
dimensions.criteria: Designs an integration test dispatching two parallel webhooks with identical event IDs.

dimensions.name: Data Remediation & Refund Safety
dimensions.criteria: Proposes a read-only audit query to isolate duplicates before issuing refunds, preventing accidental mass refunds.
